corrections: Mapped the Whack-a-Hole source folder to whack_a_mole.

after: Whack-a-Mole_V9

before: Each new mole is independently generated as a Normal Mole with 80% probability or a Golden Mole with 20% probability. The player's goal is to achieve the highest possible score before the 30-second countdown reaches 0.
after: Each new mole is independently generated as a Normal Mole with 80% probability or a Golden Mole with 20% probability.
The first mole may appear at any of the 9 holes. Every later mole must appear at a hole different from the immediately previous mole's hole.
The player's goal is to achieve the highest possible score before the 30-second countdown reaches 0.

before: The main game objects and state variables include the 9 holes, Normal Mole, Golden Mole, current mole, score, countdown, mole-related timers, and game state.
after: The main game objects and state variables include the 9 holes, Normal Mole, Golden Mole, current mole, previous mole hole, score, countdown, mole-related timers, and game state.

before: The hole is randomly selected from all 9 fixed holes. Two consecutive moles are allowed to appear at the same hole; the previous hole is not excluded from the next selection.
after: For the first mole, the hole is randomly selected from all 9 fixed holes.
After the first mole has appeared, the game stores that mole's selected hole as the previous mole hole.
For every later spawn, the new hole is randomly selected from the other 8 holes and must not equal the immediately previous mole hole.
The restriction depends only on the immediately previous mole's hole. A hole may be used again after at least one different hole has been used in between.
The next mole must appear at a hole different from the clicked mole's hole.
The next mole must still appear at a hole different from the missed mole's hole.

before: Restart resets the score, countdown, current mole, all mole-related timers, interface state, and game state. A new 0.3-second initial waiting period begins before the first mole appears.
after: Restart resets the score, countdown, current mole, previous mole hole, all mole-related timers, interface state, and game state. A new 0.3-second initial waiting period begins before the first mole appears.

before: 2. Randomly select one of the 9 holes.
after: 2. Select the spawn hole:
- For the first mole, randomly select any of the 9 holes.
- For every later mole, randomly select one of the 8 holes other than the immediately previous mole's hole.
6. Record the current mole's hole as the previous mole hole.
7. Remove the mole.
8. Begin the next 0.3-second waiting period.
The previous-hole restriction affects only hole selection and does not affect mole-type probabilities or timing.

before: At initialization, the game creates the interface and 9 fixed holes, sets Score to 0 and Time to 30, clears the current mole, initializes all mole-related timers, enters `playing`, and starts a 0.3-second initial waiting period.
after: At initialization, the game creates the interface and 9 fixed holes, sets Score to 0 and Time to 30, clears the current mole and previous mole hole, initializes all mole-related timers, enters `playing`, and starts a 0.3-second initial waiting period.

before: If Time remains above 0, the game updates the current mole cycle. During a waiting period, the waiting timer advances until one mole is spawned. While a mole is visible, its appearance timer advances and valid mouse clicks are processed. A successful click updates the score, removes the mole, and starts a new 0.3-second waiting period. If the appearance duration expires first, the mole is removed without changing the score and the same waiting period begins.
after: If Time remains above 0, the game updates the current mole cycle.
During the initial waiting period, the waiting timer advances until the first mole is spawned at any randomly selected hole.
For each later spawn, the next mole is selected from the 8 holes other than the immediately previous mole's hole.

While a mole is visible, its appearance timer advances and valid mouse clicks are processed. A successful click updates the score, records the mole's hole as the previous mole hole, removes the mole, and starts a new 0.3-second waiting period.
If the appearance duration expires first, the mole's hole is still recorded as the previous mole hole, the mole is removed without changing the score, and the same waiting period begins.

before: Pressing R fully reinitializes the game and starts a new 0.3-second initial waiting period.
after: Pressing R fully reinitializes the game, clears the previous mole hole, and starts a new 0.3-second initial waiting period.

before: During `playing`, the bottom instruction area displays `Click the mole` and `Restart: R`. When Time reaches 0, the game enters `game_over`, the current mole disappears, Score stops changing, and the bottom area displays `Game Over` and `Press R to Restart`.
after: During `playing`, the bottom instruction area displays `Click the mole` and `Restart: R`.
When Time reaches 0, the game enters `game_over`, the current mole disappears, Score stops changing, and the bottom area displays `Game Over` and `Press R to Restart`.

before: After entering `game_over`, pressing R restores Score to 0, Time to 30, clears the current mole and all mole timers, restores the normal gameplay instructions, returns the state to `playing`, and begins a new 0.3-second initial waiting period.
after: After entering `game_over`, pressing R restores Score to 0, Time to 30, clears the current mole, previous mole hole, and all mole timers, restores the normal gameplay instructions, returns the state to `playing`, and begins a new 0.3-second initial waiting period.
